description:
Fall Flowers Clipart Bundle: Autumn Floral Bouquets Vintage 
What`s included in this collection?
This clipart includes 12 PNG graphic elements. You can see all objects at the previews. All images are hand-drawn and painted digitally on iPad Pro.
What`s the format of files?
All graphic elements and illustrations are PNG format with transparent background. All files are separated in the individual file.
You can Use this clipart for your new artworks like invitations, greeting cards, wedding invitation, planner covers, printing on fabric and mugs, blog theme, webdesign, logos, planner stickers, printable art prints and posters!!!
